swe: Universitetslektor Thomas Nordström har en stark profil inom pedagogisk psykologi och utbildningsvetenskap. En stor del av hans forskning har fokuserat på läs- och skrivsvårigheter hos barn i skolan, och han är en av forskarna bakom verktyget LegiLexi som tagit fram ett omfattande stöd för att främja läsinlärning, och som idag används inom nästan alla kommuner i Sverige. Thomas har också en bakgrund som gymnasielärare i historia och psykologi.
eng: Senior Lecturer Thomas Nordström has a strong profile in educational psychology and educational science. Much of his research has focused on reading and writing difficulties in children at school, and he is one of the researchers behind the LegiLexi tool, which provides extensive support to promote and facilitate reading, and which is now used in almost all municipalities in Sweden. Thomas also has a background as a high-school teacher in history and psychology.
